title: Why You Wake Up at 3AM 😳
description:
Why do I wake up at 3am? It's not random: your sleep cycles, your wake-up hormone and the clock change are all in on it. Cyto explains it from the 6ix.

Sleep runs in roughly 90-minute cycles, deep sleep comes early, and by 3am you're in lighter, dreamier sleep that's easy to wake from. Cortisol (the wake-up hormone) climbs toward morning, and stress makes dream sleep break more easily. And since the clocks just fell back, 3 on your phone can feel like 4 to your body.

Sources (PubMed):
Buckley & Schatzberg, J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2005 — https://doi.org/10.1210/jc.2004-1056
Liyanarachchi et al., Best Pract Res Clin Endocrinol Metab 2017 — https://doi.org/10.1016/j.beem.2017.10.011
Riemann et al., J Sleep Res 2024 — https://doi.org/10.1111/jsr.14252

If it happens every night and you're wrecked all day, talk to a doctor. Not medical advice.
